Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing monitoring of a child's telephone conversations by a parent or guardian.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to monitoring of a child's telephone conversationsby a parent or guardian; and amending RCW 9.73.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9.73.080 and 2000 c 195 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, any person, otherthan a parent or legal guardian who is monitoring his or her own minorchild's telephone conversations, who violates RCW 9.73.030 is guilty ofa gross misdemeanor. (2) Any person who knowingly alters, erases, or wrongfullydiscloses any recording in violation of RCW 9.73.090(1)(c) is guilty ofa gross misdemeanor.
